explanations.C: Incorrect. 分析：创建VPC端点是为了实现网络连接，但题目并未提到需要设置网络连接或使用VPC端点。此选项与题目需求无关。错误。
explanations.D: Correct. 分析：将Redshift数据共享与Lake Formation集成，可以实现集中治理和权限管理。这是题目要求的关键步骤之一。正确。
explanations.E: Incorrect. 分析：将数据共享到Redshift Serverless工作组是实现跨账户数据访问的方式之一，但题目要求通过Lake Formation进行集中治理，而 不是直接共享到工作组。错误。

question: A company has a data lake in Amazon S3. The company uses AWS Glue to catalog data and AWS Glue Studio to implement data extract, transform, and load (ETL) pipelines. The company needs to ensure that data quality issues are checked every time the pipelines run. A data engineer must enhance the existing pipelines to evaluate data quality rules based on predefined thresholds. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST implementation effort?

options.A: Add a new transform that is defined by a SQL query to each Glue ETL job. Use the SQL query to implement a ruleset that includes the data quality rules that need to be evaluated.
options.B: Add a new Evaluate Data Quality transform to each Glue ETL job. Use Data Quality Definition Language (DQDL) to implement a ruleset that includes the data quality rules that need to be evaluated.
options.C: Add a new custom transform to each Glue ETL job. Use the PyDeequ library to implement a ruleset that includes the data quality rules that need to be evaluated.
options.D: Add a new custom transform to each Glue ETL job. Use the Great Expectations library to implement a ruleset that includes the data quality rules that need to be evaluated.

explanations.A: Incorrect. Add a new transform that is defined by a SQL query to each Glue ETL job. 优点：使用SQL查询可以实现数据质量规则的评估，SQL是常见的工具，易于理解。 缺点：需要手动编写SQL查询，缺乏专门的数据质量检查功能，可能会增加开发和维护成本。 结论：此选项正确性较低，因为它不是最简便的解决方案。
explanations.B: Correct. Add a new Evaluate Data Quality transform to each Glue ETL job. 优点：AWS Glue提供了内置的Evaluate Data Quality transform功能，可以直接使用Data Quality Definition Language (DQDL)定义规则，简化 实现过程。 缺点：无明显缺点，专门为数据质量检查设计，最符合题目要求。 结论：此选项正确性最高，是最简便的解决方案。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Add a new custom transform to each Glue ETL job. Use the PyDeequ library. 优点：PyDeequ是一个强大的数据质量检查库，支持灵活的规则定义。 缺点：需要自定义开发，增加了实现复杂性和维护成本。 结论：此选项正确性较低，因为它需要额外的开发工作，不是最简便的解决方案。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Add a new custom transform to each Glue ETL job. Use the Great Expectations library. 优点：Great Expectations是一个流行的开源数据质量检查工具，支持丰富的规则定义。 缺点：需要自定义开发，增加了实现复杂性和维护成本。 结论：此选项正确性较低，因为它需要额外的开发工作，不是最简便的解决方案。

question: A company has an application that uses a microservice architecture. The company hosts the application on an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Services (Amazon EKS) cluster. The company wants to set up a robust monitoring system for the application. The company needs to analyze the logs from the EKS cluster and the application. The company needs to correlate the cluster's logs with the application's traces to identify points of failure in the whole application request flow. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use FluentBit to collect logs. Use OpenTelemetry to collect traces.
options.B: Use Amazon CloudWatch to collect logs. Use Amazon Kinesis to collect traces.
options.C: Use Amazon CloudWatch to collect logs. Use Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK) to collect traces.
options.D: Use Amazon OpenSearch to correlate the logs and traces.
options.E: Use AWS Glue to correlate the logs and traces.

explanations.A: Correct. 正确：FluentBit是一种轻量级的日志收集工具，适合用于容器化环境（如EKS）。 正确：OpenTelemetry是一个开源框架，用于收集分布式追踪数据，能够很好地支持微服务架构。 此选项提供了日志和追踪数据的收集解决方案，且开发工作量较少。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 错误：虽然Amazon CloudWatch可以收集日志，但Amazon Kinesis主要用于实时数据流处理，而不是专门用于追踪数据的收集。 此选项不适合直接满足追踪数据收集的需求。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：Amazon MSK是一个托管的Kafka服务，主要用于流数据处理，而不是专门用于追踪数据的收集。 此选项需要额外的开发工作来实现追踪数据的收集和处理。
explanations.D: Correct. 正确：Amazon OpenSearch可以用于存储和分析日志以及追踪数据，并支持关联分析，能够帮助识别应用请求流中的故障点。 此选项提供了日志和追踪数据的关联解决方案，且开发工作量较少。
explanations.E: Incorrect. 错误：AWS Glue主要用于ETL（提取、转换、加载）任务，而不是专门用于实时日志和追踪数据的关联分析。 此选项需要额外的开发工作来实现实时关联分析。

question: A company has a gaming application that stores data in Amazon DynamoDB tables. A data engineer needs to ingest the game data into an Amazon OpenSearch Service cluster. Data updates must occur in near real time. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Step Functions to periodically export data from the Amazon DynamoDB tables to an Amazon S3 bucket. Use an AWS Lambda function to load the data into Amazon OpenSearch Service.
options.B: Configure an AWS Glue job to have a source of Amazon DynamoDB and a destination of Amazon OpenSearch Service to transfer data in near real time.
options.C: Use Amazon DynamoDB Streams to capture table changes. Use an AWS Lambda function to process and update the data in Amazon OpenSearch Service.
options.D: Use a custom OpenSearch plugin to sync data from the Amazon DynamoDB tables.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 分析：此选项使用的是定期导出数据的方式，而不是近实时更新。Step Functions的设计更适合批量处理工作流，而不是实时数据流 处理。因此，此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 分析：AWS Glue通常用于批量数据处理和ETL任务，而不是近实时数据传输。虽然AWS Glue可以连接DynamoDB和OpenSearch，但它不 适合处理实时数据流。因此，此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.C: Correct. 分析：此选项使用DynamoDB Streams捕获表更改，并通过Lambda函数处理数据更新到OpenSearch Service。这种架构是事件驱动的， 能够实现近实时数据传输，非常符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 分析：OpenSearch插件的开发和维护成本较高，且AWS官方并未提供直接支持的插件来实现DynamoDB到OpenSearch的同步。此外， 题目要求的是一种标准化的解决方案，而不是自定义开发。因此，此选项不符合题目要求。

question: A company uses Amazon Redshift as its data warehouse service. A data engineer needs to design a physical data model. The data engineer encounters a de-normalized table that is growing in size. The table does not have a suitable column to use as the distribution key. Which distribution style should the data engineer use to meet these requirements with the LEAST maintenance overhead?

options.A: ALL distribution
options.B: EVEN distribution
options.C: AUTO distribution
options.D: KEY distribution

explanations.A: Incorrect. ALL分布会将表的所有数据复制到每个节点。这种分布方式适用于小表或维度表，但对于大表来说会导致存储和维护开销过 高，因此不适合该场景。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 官方答案未选此项。正确。EVEN分布会将数据均匀分布到所有节点，适用于没有明确分布键的情况。它可以减少数据倾斜问题，但可能无法优化查询性 能。
explanations.C: Correct. AUTO分布是Amazon Redshift的默认分布样式，允许系统根据表的大小和查询模式自动选择合适的分布方式。这种方式具有最 低的维护开销，适合动态变化的场景。
explanations.D: Incorrect. KEY分布需要指定一个分布键，用于将数据分布到不同的节点。如果表中没有合适的分布键，则无法使用这种分布方式。

question: A retail company is expanding its operations globally. The company needs to use Amazon QuickSight to accurately calculate currency exchange rates for financial reports. The company has an existing dashboard that includes a visual that is based on an analysis of a dataset that contains global currency values and exchange rates. A data engineer needs to ensure that exchange rates are calculated with a precision of four decimal places. The calculations must be precomputed. The data engineer must materialize results in QuickSight super-fast, parallel, in-memory calculation engine (SPICE). Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Define and create the calculated field in the dataset.
options.B: Define and create the calculated field in the analysis.
options.C: Define and create the calculated field in the visual.
options.D: Define and create the calculated field in the dashboard.

explanations.A: Correct. 正确：在数据集中定义计算字段会将计算结果预先存储在SPICE引擎中，从而提高性能和精度。 SPICE引擎支持超快的并行内存计算，适合预计算的场景。 满足题目要求的“预计算”和“高精度”需求。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 错误：在分析中定义计算字段会导致每次加载分析时重新计算，无法利用SPICE的预计算特性。 性能较差，无法满足“超快”和“预计算”的要求。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：在可视化中定义计算字段会导致每次渲染图表时重新计算，性能较差。 无法满足“预计算”和“高精度”的要求。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：在仪表板中定义计算字段会导致每次加载仪表板时重新计算，无法利用SPICE的预计算特性。 性能较差，无法满足题目要求。

question: A company has three subsidiaries. Each subsidiary uses a different data warehousing solution. The first subsidiary hosts its data warehouse in Amazon Redshift. The second subsidiary uses Teradata Vantage on AWS. The third subsidiary uses Google BigQuery. The company wants to aggregate all the data into a central Amazon S3 data lake. The company wants to use Apache Iceberg as the table format. A data engineer needs to build a new pipeline to connect to all the data sources, run transformations by using each source engine, join the data, and write the data to Iceberg. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational effort?

options.A: Use native Amazon Redshift, Teradata, and BigQuery connectors to build the pipeline in AWS Glue. Use native AWS Glue transforms to join the data. Run a Merge operation on the data lake Iceberg table.
options.B: Use the Amazon Athena federated query connectors for Amazon Redshift, Teradata, and BigQuery to build the pipeline in Athena. Write a SQL query to read from all the data sources, join the data, and run a Merge operation on the data lake Iceberg table.
options.C: Use the native Amazon Redshift connector, the Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) connector for Teradata, and the open source Apache Spark BigQuery connector to build the pipeline in Amazon EMR. Write code in PySpark to join the data. Run a Merge operation on the data lake Iceberg table.
options.D: Use the native Amazon Redshift, Teradata, and BigQuery connectors in Amazon Appflow to write data to Amazon S3 and AWS Glue Data Catalog. Use Amazon Athena to join the data. Run a Merge operation on the data lake Iceberg table.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 使用AWS Glue构建管道： 正确性：AWS Glue支持原生连接器，可以连接到Redshift、Teradata和BigQuery，并支持数据转换和合并操作。 问题：AWS Glue的操作复杂性较高，尤其是需要手动编写ETL代码来处理复杂的转换和合并操作。对于Iceberg的支持可能需要额外配 置。 结论：虽然可行，但操作成本较高，不是最优解。
explanations.B: Correct. 使用Amazon Athena联邦查询构建管道： 正确性：Amazon Athena支持联邦查询，可以直接连接到Redshift、Teradata和BigQuery，并通过SQL查询完成数据转换和合并操作。 优势：Athena的SQL查询简化了操作，减少了手动编码的复杂性。Athena原生支持Iceberg表格式，能够直接运行Merge操作。 结论：操作成本最低，符合题目要求，是最优解。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 使用Amazon EMR构建管道： 正确性：Amazon EMR支持多种连接器（Redshift、Teradata、BigQuery），并可以使用PySpark编写代码完成数据转换和合并操作。 问题：需要手动编写PySpark代码，增加了操作复杂性。EMR的管理和维护成本较高。 结论：虽然技术上可行，但操作成本较高，不是最优解。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 使用Amazon AppFlow和Athena构建管道： 正确性：Amazon AppFlow可以将数据从Redshift、Teradata和BigQuery写入Amazon S3，并注册到AWS Glue Data Catalog。Athena可以用 来查询和合并数据。 问题：AppFlow的功能有限，无法直接处理复杂的转换和合并操作。需要额外的步骤来支持Iceberg表格式。 结论：操作成本较高，不是最优解。

question: A company is building a data stream processing application. The application runs in an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster. The application stores processed data in an Amazon DynamoDB table. The company needs the application containers in the EKS cluster to have secure access to the DynamoDB table. The company does not want to embed AWS credentials in the containers. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Store the AWS credentials in an Amazon S3 bucket. Grant the EKS containers access to the S3 bucket to retrieve the credentials.
options.B: Attach an IAM role to the EKS worker nodes, Grant the IAM role access to DynamoDUse the IAM role to set up IAM roles service accounts (IRSA) functionality.
options.C: Create an IAM user that has an access key to access the DynamoDB table. Use environment variables in the EKS containers to store the IAM user access key data.
options.D: Create an IAM user that has an access key to access the DynamoDB table. Use Kubernetes secrets that are mounted in a volume of the EKS duster nodes to store the user access key data.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 分析：此选项不符合安全最佳实践。将AWS凭证存储在S3中并让容器访问它会增加泄露风险。AWS明确建议避免将凭证存储在不安 全的地方。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Correct. Attach an IAM role to the EKS worker nodes, Grant the IAM role access to DynamoDB. Use the IAM role to set up IAM roles service accounts (IRSA) functionality. 分析：此选项符合AWS的安全最佳实践。IRSA允许EKS中的Pod使用IAM角色访问AWS服务，而无需嵌入凭证。通过IRSA，Pod可以安 全地访问DynamoDB。 结论：正确。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 分析：此选项不符合安全最佳实践。将访问密钥存储在环境变量中可能会导致凭证泄露，并且管理这些密钥的生命周期较为复杂。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Create an IAM user that has an access key to access the DynamoDB table. Use Kubernetes secrets that are mounted in a volume of the EKS cluster nodes to store the user access key data. 分析：虽然Kubernetes Secrets可以提供一定的安全性，但使用IAM用户访问AWS服务仍然不是最佳实践。IRSA是更推荐的解决方案。 结论：错误。

question: A data engineer needs to onboard a new data producer into AWS. The data producer needs to migrate data products to AWS. The data producer maintains many data pipelines that support a business application. Each pipeline must have service accounts and their corresponding credentials. The data engineer must establish a secure connection from the data producer's on-premises data center to AWS. The data engineer must not use the public internet to transfer data from an on-premises data center to AWS. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Instruct the new data producer to create Amazon Machine Images (AMIs) on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) to store the code base of the application. Create security groups in a public subnet that allow connections only to the on-premises data center.
options.B: Create an AWS Direct Connect connection to the on-premises data center. Store the service account credentials in AWS Secrets manager.
options.C: Create a security group in a public subnet. Configure the security group to allow only connections from the CIDR blocks that correspond to the data producer. Create Amazon S3 buckets than contain presigned URLS that have one-day expiration dates.
options.D: Create an AWS Direct Connect connection to the on-premises data center. Store the application keys in AWS Secrets Manager. Create Amazon S3 buckets that contain presigned URLS that have one-day expiration dates.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误：虽然安全组可以限制连接来源，但使用公共子网意味着数据仍然可能通过公共互联网传输，这不符合题目要求。 错误：题目要求的是数据迁移，而不是存储代码库，创建AMIs并不解决数据传输问题。
explanations.B: Correct. 正确：AWS Direct Connect提供专用网络连接，避免使用公共互联网，符合题目要求。 正确：AWS Secrets Manager是安全存储服务账户凭证的推荐方式。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：使用公共子网意味着数据可能通过公共互联网传输，这不符合题目要求。 错误：预签名URL适用于临时访问，但并未解决安全连接和凭证管理问题。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 部分正确：AWS Direct Connect提供专用网络连接，符合题目要求。 错误：存储应用程序密钥而非服务账户凭证不完全符合题目要求。 错误：预签名URL的使用与题目要求的安全连接和凭证管理无关。

question: A data engineer configured an AWS Glue Data Catalog for data that is stored in Amazon S3 buckets. The data engineer needs to configure the Data Catalog to receive incremental updates. The data engineer sets up event notifications for the S3 bucket and creates an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue to receive the S3 events. Which combination of steps should the data engineer take to meet these requirements with LEAST operational overhead? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create an S3 event-based AWS Glue crawler to consume events from the SQS queue.
options.B: Define a time-based schedule to run the AWS Glue crawler, and perform incremental updates to the Data Catalog.
options.C: Use an AWS Lambda function to directly update the Data Catalog based on S3 events that the SQS queue receives.
options.D: Manually initiate the AWS Glue crawler to perform updates to the Data Catalog when there is a change in the S3 bucket.
options.E: Use AWS Step Functions to orchestrate the process of updating the Data Catalog based on S3 events that the SQS queue receives.

explanations.A: Correct. AWS Glue支持基于S3事件的爬网器，可以通 过SQS队列接收事件并触发爬网器。这种方式可以实现自动化的增量更新，减少人工干预和操作开销。
explanations.B: Correct. 通过时间调度运行 AWS Glue爬网器是一种常见的方式，可以定期更新Data Catalog。虽然这种方式不是完全事件驱动，但它可以确保数据的定期更新， 适合某些场景。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 虽然AWS Lambda 可以处理SQS队列中的事件，但直接更新Data Catalog需要额外的编程和维护工作，增加了操作开销，不符合题目要求的“LEAST operational overhead”。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 手动启动爬 网器显然增加了操作开销，不符合题目要求的“LEAST operational overhead”。
explanations.E: Incorrect. 虽 然AWS Step Functions可以编排复杂的工作流，但它的使用增加了系统复杂性和操作开销，不符合题目要求的“LEAST operational overhead”。

question: A company uses AWS Glue Data Catalog to index data that is uploaded to an Amazon S3 bucket every day. The company uses a daily batch processes in an extract, transform, and load (ETL) pipeline to upload data from external sources into the S3 bucket. The company runs a daily report on the S3 data. Some days, the company runs the report before all the daily data has been uploaded to the S3 bucket. A data engineer must be able to send a message that identifies any incomplete data to an existing Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create data quality checks for the source datasets that the daily reports use. Create a new AWS managed Apache Airflow cluster. Run the data quality checks by using Airflow tasks that run data quality queries on the columns data type and the presence of null values. Configure Airflow Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs) to send an email notification that informs the data engineer about the incomplete datasets to the SNS topic.
options.B: Create data quality checks on the source datasets that the daily reports use. Create a new Amazon EMR cluster. Use Apache Spark SQL to create Apache Spark jobs in the EMR cluster that run data quality queries on the columns data type and the presence of null values. Orchestrate the ETL pipeline by using an AWS Step Functions workflow. Configure the workflow to send an email notification that informs the data engineer about the incomplete datasets to the SNS topic.
options.C: Create data quality checks on the source datasets that the daily reports use. Create data quality actions by using AWS Glue workflows to confirm the completeness and consistency of the datasets. Configure the data quality actions to create an event in Amazon EventBridge if a dataset is incomplete. Configure EventBridge to send the event that informs the data engineer about the incomplete datasets to the Amazon SNS topic.
options.D: Create AWS Lambda functions that run data quality queries on the columns data type and the presence of null values. Orchestrate the ETL pipeline by using an AWS Step Functions workflow that runs the Lambda functions. Configure the Step Functions workflow to send an email notification that informs the data engineer about the incomplete datasets to the SNS topic.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 使用Apache Airflow进行数据质量检查 正确性：Apache Airflow可以用于数据质量检查和任务编排，但需要额外的管理和维护托管集群，增加了操作开销。 错误原因：题目要求最少的操作开销，而托管Airflow集群需要额外的资源和配置，违背了题目要求。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 使用Amazon EMR和Step Functions进行数据质量检查 正确性：Amazon EMR和Step Functions可以实现数据质量检查和工作流编排。 错误原因：Amazon EMR需要管理集群，增加了操作开销。相比AWS Glue，EMR的设置和维护复杂度更高。
explanations.C: Correct. 使用AWS Glue工作流和EventBridge进行数据质量检查 正确性：AWS Glue工作流可以直接集成数据质量检查，EventBridge可以实现事件驱动通知，SNS可以发送消息。 正确原因：此选项利用了AWS Glue的原生功能，减少了额外的管理开销，同时满足了题目要求的最少操作开销。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 使用AWS Lambda和Step Functions进行数据质量检查 正确性：AWS Lambda和Step Functions可以实现数据质量检查和工作流编排。 错误原因：虽然Lambda函数是无服务器的，但需要额外编写和管理函数逻辑，增加了开发和维护成本。相比AWS Glue，操作开销更 高。

question: A company stores customer data that contains personally identifiable information (PII) in an Amazon Redshift cluster. The company's marketing, claims, and analytics teams need to be able to access the customer data. The marketing team should have access to obfuscated claim information but should have full access to customer contact information. The claims team should have access to customer information for each claim that the team processes. The analytics team should have access only to obfuscated PII data. Which solution will enforce these data access requirements with the LEAST administrative overhead?

options.A: Create a separate Redshift cluster for each team. Load only the required data for each team. Restrict access to clusters based on the teams.
options.B: Create views that include required fields for each of the data requirements. Grant the teams access only to the view that each team requires.
options.C: Create a separate Amazon Redshift database role for each team. Define masking policies that apply for each team separately. Attach appropriate masking policies to each team role.
options.D: Move the customer data to an Amazon S3 bucket. Use AWS Lake Formation to create a data lake. Use fine-grained security capabilities to grant each team appropriate permissions to access the data.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 分析：此选项通过为每个团队创建单独的Redshift集群来实现数据隔离，但这种方法会导致高昂的管理开销（多个集群的维护、成本 增加）。此外，这种方法不够灵活，无法动态调整数据访问权限。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 分析：此选项通过创建视图来限制数据访问，视图可以满足不同团队的需求，但它无法直接实现数据屏蔽（如PII数据的模糊处 理）。此外，视图的管理可能会随着需求变化而变得复杂。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: Correct. 分析：此选项通过Redshift的数据库角色和屏蔽策略实现数据访问控制。屏蔽策略可以动态地模糊处理PII数据，同时根据团队角色分 配权限。这种方法灵活且管理开销较低。 结论：正确。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 分析：此选项通过AWS Lake Formation实现数据权限管理，但将数据从Redshift迁移到S3会增加额外的复杂性和管理开销。此外，题目 中明确提到数据存储在Redshift中，因此此选项不符合题目要求。 结论：错误。

question: A financial company recently added more features to its mobile app. The new features required the company to create a new topic in an existing Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK) cluster. A few days after the company added the new topic, Amazon CloudWatch raised an alarm on the RootDiskUsed metric for the MSK cluster. How should the company address the CloudWatch alarm?

options.A: Expand the storage of the MSK broker. Configure the MSK cluster storage to expand automatically.
options.B: Expand the storage of the Apache ZooKeeper nodes.
options.C: Update the MSK broker instance to a larger instance type. Restart the MSK cluster.
options.D: Specify the Target Volume-in-GiB parameter for the existing topic.

explanations.A: Correct. 正确：当 CloudWatch 报告 RootDiskUsed 指标告警时，通常是因为 MSK broker 的存储空间不足。扩展存储是解决此问题的正确方法。 自动扩展存储是推荐的最佳实践，可以避免未来类似问题。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 错误：Apache ZooKeeper 的存储与 MSK broker 的存储是分开的。RootDiskUsed 指标是针对 MSK broker 的，而不是 ZooKeeper 节点。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：更大的实例类型可能会增加计算能力，但不会直接解决存储不足的问题。RootDiskUsed 是存储相关的指标，而不是计算资源 相关的指标。 重新启动 MSK 集群可能会导致服务中断，不是最佳解决方案。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：Target Volume-in-GiB 参数并不是 MSK 的配置选项。此选项与问题无关。

question: A data engineer needs to build an enterprise data catalog based on the company's Amazon S3 buckets and Amazon RDS databases. The data catalog must include storage format metadata for the data in the catalog. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST effort?

options.A: Use an AWS Glue crawler to scan the S3 buckets and RDS databases and build a data catalog. Use data stewards to inspect the data and update the data catalog with the data format.
options.B: Use an AWS Glue crawler to build a data catalog. Use AWS Glue crawler classifiers to recognize the format of data and store the format in the catalog.
options.C: Use Amazon Macie to build a data catalog and to identify sensitive data elements. Collect the data format information from Macie.
options.D: Use scripts to scan data elements and to assign data classifications based on the format of the data.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 正确性分析：AWS Glue crawler确实可以扫描S3和RDS并构建数据目录，但依赖数据管理员手动检查和更新数据格式会增加人工工作 量，不符合“最少努力”的要求。 结论：此选项错误。
explanations.B: Correct. 正确性分析：AWS Glue crawler可以自动扫描数据源并构建数据目录，同时AWS Glue的分类器（classifier）能够自动识别数据格式并存 储到目录中，完全符合题目要求且最少人工干预。 结论：此选项正确。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 正确性分析：Amazon Macie主要用于识别敏感数据（如PII），而不是构建数据目录或识别数据格式。此选项与题目要求不符。 结论：此选项错误。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 正确性分析：使用脚本手动扫描和分类数据格式需要大量开发和维护工作，不符合“最少努力”的要求。 结论：此选项错误。

question: A company analyzes data in a data lake every quarter to perform inventory assessments. A data engineer uses AWS Glue DataBrew to detect any personally identifiable formation (PII) about customers within the data. The company's privacy policy considers some custom categories of information to be PII. However, the categories are not included in standard DataBrew data quality rules. The data engineer needs to modify the current process to scan for the custom PII categories across multiple datasets within the data lake. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Manually review the data for custom PII categories.
options.B: Implement custom data quality rules in DataBrew. Apply the custom rules across datasets.
options.C: Develop custom Python scripts to detect the custom PII categories. Call the scripts from DataBrew.
options.D: Implement regex patterns to extract PII information from fields during extract transform, and load (ETL) operations into the data lake.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误：手动审查数据效率低下，尤其是对于大规模数据集，操作复杂度高且容易出错。 不符合“LEAST operational overhead”的要求。
explanations.B: Correct. 正确：DataBrew支持自定义数据质量规则，可以根据公司的隐私政策定义自定义PII类别。 通过自动化规则应用于多个数据集，减少了操作复杂度。 符合“LEAST operational overhead”的要求。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：开发和维护自定义Python脚本需要额外的开发工作和技术资源。 增加了操作复杂度，不符合“LEAST operational overhead”的要求。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：虽然正则表达式可以有效检测PII，但在ETL过程中实现和维护正则表达式会增加复杂度。 ETL操作通常需要额外的资源和时间，不符合“LEAST operational overhead”的要求。

question: A company receives a data file from a partner each day in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company uses a daily AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) pipeline to clean and transform each data file. The output of the ETL pipeline is written to a CSV file named Daily.csv in a second S3 bucket. Occasionally, the daily data file is empty or is missing values for required fields. When the file is missing data, the company can use the previous day’s CSV file. A data engineer needs to ensure that the previous day's data file is overwritten only if the new daily file is complete and valid. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST effort?

options.A: Invoke an AWS Lambda function to check the file for missing data and to fill in missing values in required fields.
options.B: Configure the AWS Glue ETL pipeline to use AWS Glue Data Quality rules. Develop rules in Data Quality Definition Language (DQDL) to check for missing values in required fields and empty files.
options.C: Use AWS Glue Studio to change the code in the ETL pipeline to fill in any missing values in the required fields with the most common values for each field.
options.D: Run a SQL query in Amazon Athena to read the CSV file and drop missing rows. Copy the corrected CSV file to the second S3 bucket.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误：虽然 AWS Lambda 可以用来检查文件的完整性，但实现数据质量检查和填充缺失值的逻辑需要额外的开发工作，增加了复杂 性。 不符合题目要求的“最少努力”原则。
explanations.B: Correct. 正确：AWS Glue Data Quality 是专门设计用于检查数据质量的工具，可以通过 DQDL 定义规则来自动化数据完整性检查。 符合题目要求的“最少努力”原则，因为它直接集成到 AWS Glue ETL 管道中，无需额外开发工作。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：虽然可以通过 AWS Glue Studio 修改 ETL 代码，但这需要手动编写逻辑来处理缺失值，增加了开发工作量。 不符合题目要求的“最少努力”原则。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：使用 Amazon Athena 需要额外的步骤来运行 SQL 查询并处理数据，这增加了操作复杂性。 不符合题目要求的“最少努力”原则。

question: A marketing company uses Amazon S3 to store marketing data. The company uses versioning in some buckets. The company runs several jobs to read and load data into the buckets. To help cost-optimize its storage, the company wants to gather information about incomplete multipart uploads and outdated versions that are present in the S3 buckets. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational effort?

options.A: Use AWS CLI to gather the information.
options.B: Use Amazon S3 Inventory configurations reports to gather the information.
options.C: Use the Amazon S3 Storage Lens dashboard to gather the information.
options.D: Use AWS usage reports for Amazon S3 to gather the information.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误：虽然AWS CLI可以手动列出S3存储桶中的对象和版本，但它需要用户编写脚本来过滤和分析数据，操作复杂且不符合“最少操 作努力”的要求。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 错误：S3 Inventory可以生成有关存储桶内容的报告，但它无法直接提供关于“未完成的分段上传”和“过时版本”的信息。
explanations.C: Correct. 正确：S3 Storage Lens提供了一个全面的仪表板，可以直接显示有关未完成的分段上传和版本控制的信息，且操作简单，符合“最少 操作努力”的要求。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：AWS使用报告主要用于跟踪服务使用量和成本，而不是提供详细的存储桶内容信息。

question: A gaming company uses Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to collect clickstream data. The company uses Amazon Data Firehose delivery streams to store the data in JSON format in Amazon S3. Data scientists at the company use Amazon Athena to query the most recent data to obtain business insights. The company wants to reduce Athena costs but does not want to recreate the data pipeline. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST management effort?

options.A: Change the Firehose output format to Apache Parquet. Provide a custom S3 object YYYYMMDD prefix expression and specify a large buffer size. For the existing data, create an AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) job. Configure the ETL job to combine small JSON files, convert the JSON files to large Parquet files, and add the YYYYMMDD prefix. Use the ALTER TABLE ADD PARTITION statement to reflect the partition on the existing Athena table.
options.B: Create an Apache Spark job that combines JSON files and converts the JSON files to Apache Parquet files. Launch an Amazon EMR ephemeral cluster every day to run the Spark job to create new Parquet files in a different S3 location. Use the ALTER TABLE SET LOCATION statement to reflect the new S3 location on the existing Athena table.
options.C: Create a Kinesis data stream as a delivery destination for Firehose. Use Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink (previously known as Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics) to run Apache Flink on the Kinesis data stream. Use Flink to aggregate the data and save the data to Amazon S3 in Apache Parquet format with a custom S3 object YYYYMMDD prefix. Use the ALTER TABLE ADD PARTITION statement to reflect the partition on the existing Athena table.
options.D: Integrate an AWS Lambda function with Firehose to convert source records to Apache Parquet and write them to Amazon S3. In parallel, run an AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) job to combine the JSON files and convert the JSON files to large Parquet files. Create a custom S3 object YYYYMMDD prefix. Use the ALTER TABLE ADD PARTITION statement to reflect the partition on the existing Athena table.

explanations.A: Correct. Change the Firehose output format to Apache Parquet... 分析： 将Firehose输出格式更改为Apache Parquet可以显著减少Athena查询成本，因为Parquet是一种列式存储格式，查询效率更高。 使用AWS Glue ETL作业处理现有JSON数据并转换为Parquet格式是一个合理的解决方案。 通过ALTER TABLE ADD PARTITION语句更新Athena表分区，确保新数据能够被查询。 此选项直接利用现有的Firehose和Athena架构，管理工作量较低。 结论：正确。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Create an Apache Spark job... 分析： 使用Amazon EMR临时集群运行Apache Spark作业会增加管理复杂性，因为需要每天启动和管理EMR集群。 虽然可以将JSON转换为Parquet格式，但ALTER TABLE SET LOCATION操作会替换整个表的存储位置，而不是添加分区，可能导致数据 管理问题。 此选项的管理工作量较高，不符合“LEAST management effort”的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Create a Kinesis data stream as a delivery destination... 分析： 使用Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink处理数据流并转换为Parquet格式是一个有效的解决方案，但需要额外配置和管理Flink作 业。 此选项引入了新的组件（Kinesis数据流和Flink），增加了架构复杂性和管理工作量。 不符合“LEAST management effort”的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Integrate an AWS Lambda function with Firehose... 分析： 将Lambda与Firehose集成以转换数据格式是一个可行的方案，但需要额外开发和维护Lambda函数。 同时运行AWS Glue ETL作业会增加管理复杂性，因为需要协调两个不同的处理流程。 此选项的管理工作量较高，不符合“LEAST management effort”的要求。 结论：错误。

question: A company needs a solution to manage costs for an existing Amazon DynamoDB table. The company also needs to control the size of the table. The solution must not disrupt any ongoing read or write operations. The company wants to use a solution that automatically deletes data from the table after 1 month. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST ongoing maintenance?

options.A: Use the DynamoDB TTL feature to automatically expire data based on timestamps.
options.B: Configure a scheduled Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function to check for data that is older than 1 month. Configure the Lambda function to delete old data.
options.C: Configure a stream on the DynamoDB table to invoke an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to delete data in the table that is older than 1 month.
options.D: Use an AWS Lambda function to periodically scan the DynamoDB table for data that is older than 1 month. Configure the Lambda function to delete old data.

explanations.A: Correct. 正确：DynamoDB TTL是专门设计用于自动删除过期数据的功能。它基于时间戳字段，能够自动清理数据而无需额外的维护。 符合要求：不会中断读写操作，且是最少维护的解决方案。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 错误：虽然可以通过EventBridge定期触发Lambda函数来删除数据，但这种方法需要额外的开发和维护工作。 不符合要求：需要手动编写Lambda函数逻辑，且维护成本较高。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：DynamoDB Streams主要用于捕获表中数据的变化，而不是用于定期清理数据。 不符合要求：需要额外的开发工作，且可能会影响性能。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：定期扫描DynamoDB表会产生额外的成本和性能开销，尤其是对于大表。 不符合要求：维护成本较高，且可能中断读写操作。

question: A company uses Amazon S3 to store data and Amazon QuickSight to create visualizations, The company has an S3 bucket in an AWS account named Hub-Account. The S3 bucket is encrypted by an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key. The company's QuickSight instance is in a separate account named BI-Account. The company updates the S3 bucket policy to grant access to the QuickSight service role. The company wants to enable cross-account access to allow QuickSight to interact with the S3 bucket. Which combination of steps will meet this requirement? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use the existing AWS KMS key to encrypt connections from QuickSight to the S3 bucket.
options.B: Add the S3 bucket as a resource that the QuickSight service role can access.
options.C: Use AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) to share the S3 bucket with the BI-Account account.
options.D: Add an IAM policy to the QuickSight service role to give QuickSight access to the KMS key that encrypts the S3 bucket.
options.E: Add the KMS key as a resource that the QuickSight service role can access.

explanations.A: Incorrect. AWS KMS密钥用于加密存储在S3中的数据，而不是用于加密连接。连接加密通常由TLS协议处理，与KMS无关。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 官方答案未选此项。正确。QuickSight服务角色需要访问S3 bucket的权限，更新S3 bucket策略以允许服务角色访问是实现跨账户访问的必要步骤。
explanations.C: Incorrect. AWS RAM主要用于共享资源（如子网、Transit Gateway等），而不是用于直接共享S3 bucket。S3 bucket的跨账户访问通常通过 bucket策略或IAM角色实现。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 官方答案未选此项。正确。QuickSight服务角色需要访问加密S3 bucket的KMS密钥权限，否则无法解密数据。
explanations.E: Correct. QuickSight服务角色需要显式地被授予访问KMS密钥的权限，以便解密S3 bucket中的数据。

question: A car sales company maintains data about cars that are listed for sale in an area. The company receives data about new car listings from vendors who upload the data daily as compressed files into Amazon S3. The compressed files are up to 5 KB in size. The company wants to see the most up-to-date listings as soon as the data is uploaded to Amazon S3. A data engineer must automate and orchestrate the data processing workflow of the listings to feed a dashboard. The data engineer must also provide the ability to perform one-time queries and analytical reporting. The query solution must be scalable. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use an Amazon EMR cluster to process incoming data. Use AWS Step Functions to orchestrate workflows. Use Apache Hive for one-time queries and analytical reporting. Use Amazon OpenSearch Service to bulk ingest the data into compute optimized instances. Use OpenSearch Dashboards in OpenSearch Service for the dashboard.
options.B: Use a provisioned Amazon EMR cluster to process incoming data. Use AWS Step Functions to orchestrate workflows. Use Amazon Athena for one-time queries and analytical reporting. Use Amazon QuickSight for the dashboard.
options.C: Use AWS Glue to process incoming data. Use AWS Step Functions to orchestrate workflows. Use Amazon Redshift Spectrum for one-time queries and analytical reporting. Use OpenSearch Dashboards in Amazon OpenSearch Service for the dashboard.
options.D: Use AWS Glue to process incoming data. Use AWS Lambda and S3 Event Notifications to orchestrate workflows. Use Amazon Athena for one-time queries and analytical reporting. Use Amazon QuickSight for the dashboard.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 使用 Amazon EMR 集群处理传入数据，使用 AWS Step Functions 编排工作流，使用 Apache Hive 进行一次性查询和分析报告，使用 Amazon OpenSearch Service 批量导入数据到计算优化实例中，使用 OpenSearch Dashboards 作为仪表板。 Amazon EMR 是一个强大的工具，但对于处理小型文件（如 5 KB 的文件）来说，成本较高且不够高效。 Apache Hive 是一个适用于大规模数据处理的工具，但它的查询性能不如 Amazon Athena，且需要额外的集群管理。 OpenSearch Dashboards 是一个可视化工具，但它更适合搜索和日志分析，而不是通用的分析和报表。 此选项的成本较高，且不完全满足题目中“最具成本效益”的要求。 错误原因： 成本高且不完全符合需求。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 使用预置的 Amazon EMR 集群处理传入数据，使用 AWS Step Functions 编排工作流，使用 Amazon Athena 进行一次性查询和分析报 告，使用 Amazon QuickSight 作为仪表板。 预置的 Amazon EMR 集群需要持续运行，成本较高，且对于小型文件处理不够高效。 Amazon Athena 是一个合适的选择，用于一次性查询和分析报告。 Amazon QuickSight 是一个合适的选择，用于仪表板和可视化。 此选项的主要问题在于 EMR 的成本和效率问题。 错误原因： EMR 的成本较高，不适合小型文件处理。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 使用 AWS Glue 处理传入数据，使用 AWS Step Functions 编排工作流，使用 Amazon Redshift Spectrum 进行一次性查询和分析报告， 使用 OpenSearch Dashboards 作为仪表板。 AWS Glue 是一个合适的选择，用于处理传入数据。 Amazon Redshift Spectrum 是一个强大的查询工具，但它需要 Redshift 集群的支持，成本较高且复杂度增加。 OpenSearch Dashboards 不适合通用的分析和报表需求。 此选项的主要问题在于 Redshift Spectrum 的成本和复杂性，以及 OpenSearch Dashboards 的不适用性。 错误原因： Redshift Spectrum 和 OpenSearch Dashboards 不完全符合需求。
explanations.D: Correct. 使用 AWS Glue 处理传入数据，使用 AWS Lambda 和 S3 Event Notifications 编排工作流，使用 Amazon Athena 进行一次性查询和分析 报告，使用 Amazon QuickSight 作为仪表板。 AWS Glue 是一个合适的选择，用于处理传入数据。 AWS Lambda 和 S3 Event Notifications 是一个高效且低成本的解决方案，用于自动化和编排工作流。 Amazon Athena 是一个无服务器查询工具，适合一次性查询和分析报告。 Amazon QuickSight 是一个合适的选择，用于仪表板和可视化。 此选项满足题目中“最具成本效益”的要求。 正确原因： 成本低，架构高效，完全符合需求。

question: A company has AWS resources in multiple AWS Regions. The company has an Amazon EFS file system in each Region where the company operates. The company’s data science team operates within only a single Region. The data that the data science team works with must remain within the team's Region. A data engineer needs to create a single dataset by processing files that are in each of the company's Regional EFS file systems. The data engineer wants to use an AWS Step Functions state machine to orchestrate AWS Lambda functions to process the data. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST effort?

options.A: Peer the VPCs that host the EFS file systems in each Region with the VPC that is in the data science team’s Region. Enable EFS file locking. Configure the Lambda functions in the data science team's Region to mount each of the Region specific file systems. Use the Lambda functions to process the data.
options.B: Configure each of the Regional EFS file systems to replicate data to the data science team's Region. In the data science team’s Region, configure the Lambda functions to mount the replica file systems. Use the Lambda functions to process the data.
options.C: Deploy the Lambda functions to each Region. Mount the Regional EFS file systems to the Lambda functions. Use the Lambda functions to process the data. Store the output in an Amazon S3 bucket in the data science team’s Region.
options.D: Use AWS DataSync to transfer files from each of the Regional EFS files systems to the file system that is in the data science team's Region. Configure the Lambda functions in the data science team's Region to mount the file system that is in the same Region. Use the Lambda functions to process the data.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 对托管每个区域EFS文件系统的VPC与数据科学团队所在区域的VPC进行对等连接。 错误：VPC对等连接可以实现跨区域网络通信，但EFS文件系统无法直接跨区域挂载。 错误：启用EFS文件锁定并不能解决跨区域数据访问的问题。 错误：Lambda函数无法直接挂载跨区域的EFS文件系统。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 将每个区域的EFS文件系统配置为将数据复制到数据科学团队所在的区域。 错误：EFS本身不支持跨区域复制功能，无法直接将数据复制到另一个区域。 错误：需要额外的工具（如DataSync）来实现跨区域数据传输。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 将Lambda函数部署到每个区域。 正确：Lambda函数可以部署到每个区域并挂载区域内的EFS文件系统。 错误：这种方法需要在多个区域部署Lambda函数，增加了管理复杂性，不符合“最少努力”的要求。
explanations.D: Correct. 使用AWS DataSync将每个区域EFS文件系统中的文件传输到数据科学团队所在区域的文件系统。 正确：AWS DataSync是专门设计用于高效传输数据的服务，支持跨区域数据传输。 正确：在数据科学团队所在区域挂载单一的EFS文件系统，简化了Lambda函数的配置和管理。 正确：这种方法符合“最少努力”的要求，同时满足数据处理需求。

question: A company hosts its applications on Amazon EC2 instances. The company must use SSL/TLS connections that encrypt data in transit to communicate securely with AWS infrastructure that is managed by a customer. A data engineer needs to implement a solution to simplify the generation, distribution, and rotation of digital certificates. The solution must automatically renew and deploy SSL/TLS certificates. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Store self-managed certificates on the EC2 instances.
options.B: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM).
options.C: Implement custom automation scripts in AWS Secrets Manager.
options.D: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) Service Connect.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误：自管理证书需要手动生成、分发和续订，增加了操作复杂性和维护成本。 不符合题目要求的“自动化”和“最少的操作开销”。
explanations.B: Correct. 正确：AWS Certificate Manager (ACM)是专门设计用于简化SSL/TLS证书的管理。 ACM支持自动生成、分发、续订和部署证书，完全符合题目要求的“自动化”和“最少的操作开销”。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：虽然AWS Secrets Manager可以存储敏感信息，但需要额外编写和维护自定义脚本来管理证书。 增加了开发和维护的复杂性，不符合“最少的操作开销”要求。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：Amazon ECS Service Connect主要用于服务间通信的连接管理，与SSL/TLS证书的管理无直接关系。 不符合题目要求的功能范围。

question: A company saves customer data to an Amazon S3 bucket. The company uses server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS) to encrypt the bucket. The dataset includes personally identifiable information (PII) such as social security numbers and account details. Data that is tagged as PII must be masked before the company uses customer data for analysis. Some users must have secure access to the PII data during the pre-processing phase. The company needs a low-maintenance solution to mask and secure the PII data throughout the entire engineering pipeline. Which combination of solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use AWS Glue DataBrew to perform extract, transform, and load (ETL) tasks that mask the PII data before analysis.
options.B: Use Amazon GuardDuty to monitor access patterns for the PII data that is used in the engineering pipeline.
options.C: Configure an Amazon Macie discovery job for the S3 bucket.
options.D: Use AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) to manage permissions and to control access to the PII data.
options.E: Write custom scripts in an application to mask the PII data and to control access.

explanations.A: Correct. 分析：正确。AWS Glue DataBrew是一种低维护的服务，专门用于数据预处理和屏蔽敏感信息（如PII数据）。它可以自动化ETL任务并 提供内置的屏蔽功能，非常适合此场景。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 分析：错误。Amazon GuardDuty主要用于检测恶意活动和异常行为，而不是直接用于屏蔽或控制PII数据的访问。此选项与题目要求 不匹配。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 分析：错误。Amazon Macie可以发现和分类敏感数据（如PII），但它并不直接提供屏蔽或控制访问的功能。虽然它可以帮助识别PII数 据，但题目要求的是屏蔽和安全访问。
explanations.D: Correct. 分析：正确。IAM是AWS的核心服务，用于管理权限和控制访问。通过IAM策略，可以确保只有授权用户能够访问PII数据，从而满足 安全访问的要求。
explanations.E: Incorrect. 分析：错误。编写自定义脚本是一种高维护的解决方案，与题目要求的低维护解决方案不符。此外，AWS提供了许多现成的服务 （如Glue DataBrew和IAM），无需额外编写脚本。

question: A data engineer is launching an Amazon EMR cluster. The data that the data engineer needs to load into the new cluster is currently in an Amazon S3 bucket. The data engineer needs to ensure that data is encrypted both at rest and in transit. The data that is in the S3 bucket is encrypted by an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key. The data engineer has an Amazon S3 path that has a Privacy Enhanced Mail (PEM) file. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon EMR security configuration. Specify the appropriate AWS KMS key for at-rest encryption for the S3 bucket. Create a second security configuration. Specify the Amazon S3 path of the PEM file for in-transit encryption. Create the EMR cluster, and attach both security configurations to the cluster.
options.B: Create an Amazon EMR security configuration. Specify the appropriate AWS KMS key for local disk encryption for the S3 bucket. Specify the Amazon S3 path of the PEM file for in-transit encryption. Use the security configuration during EMR cluster creation.
options.C: Create an Amazon EMR security configuration. Specify the appropriate AWS KMS key for at-rest encryption for the S3 bucket. Specify the Amazon S3 path of the PEM file for in-transit encryption. Use the security configuration during EMR cluster creation.
options.D: Create an Amazon EMR security configuration. Specify the appropriate AWS KMS key for at-rest encryption for the S3 bucket. Specify the Amazon S3 path of the PEM file for in-transit encryption. Create the EMR cluster, and attach the security configuration to the cluster.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 创建两个安全配置并分别指定静态加密和传输加密。 错误：Amazon EMR安全配置是单一的配置文件，不能同时附加两个安全配置到一个EMR集群。此选项的操作不符合AWS的实际使用 方式。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 为S3存储桶的本地磁盘加密指定AWS KMS密钥。 错误：题目要求的是S3存储桶的静态加密，而不是本地磁盘加密。此选项混淆了加密的范围，且其他部分的描述是正确的。
explanations.C: Correct. 为S3存储桶的静态加密指定AWS KMS密钥，并为传输加密指定PEM文件路径。 正确：此选项符合题目要求，使用单一的安全配置文件，同时指定静态加密和传输加密，并在EMR集群创建时应用该安全配置。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 创建安全配置并在集群创建后附加。 错误：安全配置必须在EMR集群创建时指定，而不是在创建后附加。此选项的操作顺序不正确。

question: A retail company is using an Amazon Redshift cluster to support real-time inventory management. The company has deployed an ML model on a real-time endpoint in Amazon SageMaker. The company wants to make real-time inventory recommendations. The company also wants to make predictions about future inventory needs. Which solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use Amazon Redshift ML to generate inventory recommendations.
options.B: Use SQL to invoke a remote SageMaker endpoint for prediction.
options.C: Use Amazon Redshift ML to schedule regular data exports for offline model training.
options.D: Use SageMaker Autopilot to create inventory management dashboards in Amazon Redshift.
options.E: Use Amazon Redshift as a file storage system to archive old inventory management reports.

explanations.A: Correct. 分析：正确。Amazon Redshift ML允许用户直接在Redshift中使用机器学习模型进行预测和推荐。这符合题目要求的实时库存推荐功 能。
explanations.B: Correct. 分析：正确。通过SQL调用Amazon SageMaker的实时端点，可以实现实时预测功能。这符合题目要求的实时预测和未来库存需求预 测。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 分析：错误。题目要求的是实时预测和推荐，而不是离线模型训练。此选项与题目需求不符。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 分析：错误。SageMaker Autopilot用于自动化机器学习模型的训练和优化，而不是直接创建仪表板。此选项与题目需求不符。
explanations.E: Incorrect. 分析：错误。Amazon Redshift是一个数据仓库解决方案，而不是文件存储系统。此选项与题目需求不符。

question: A company stores CSV files in an Amazon S3 bucket. A data engineer needs to process the data in the CSV files and store the processed data in a new S3 bucket. The process needs to rename a column, remove specific columns, ignore the second row of each file, create a new column based on the values of the first row of the data, and filter the results by a numeric value of a column. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

options.A: Use AWS Glue Python jobs to read and transform the CSV files.
options.B: Use an AWS Glue custom crawler to read and transform the CSV files.
options.C: Use an AWS Glue workflow to build a set of jobs to crawl and transform the CSV files.
options.D: Use AWS Glue DataBrew recipes to read and transform the CSV files.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 正确性分析：AWS Glue Python jobs 是一种灵活的方式，可以实现复杂的 ETL 任务，包括列重命名、删除列、忽略行、创建新列和过 滤数据。但需要编写自定义代码，开发工作量较大。 结论：虽然可以满足需求，但开发工作量较高，不符合“LEAST development effort”的要求。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 正确性分析：AWS Glue custom crawler 的主要功能是自动发现数据架构，并生成数据目录。它不具备直接进行数据转换的能力。 结论：无法满足题目中复杂的数据处理需求。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 正确性分析：AWS Glue workflow 可以组织多个 Glue jobs 和 crawlers，但仍需要编写自定义代码来实现数据转换。开发工作量较大。 结论：虽然可以满足需求，但开发工作量较高，不符合“LEAST development effort”的要求。
explanations.D: Correct. 正确性分析：AWS Glue DataBrew 是一种可视化数据准备工具，支持通过“recipes”轻松实现列重命名、删除列、忽略行、创建新列和 过滤数据等操作。无需编写代码，开发工作量最小。 结论：完全满足需求，并且开发工作量最小。

question: A company uses Amazon Redshift as its data warehouse. Data encoding is applied to the existing tables of the data warehouse. A data engineer discovers that the compression encoding applied to some of the tables is not the best fit for the data. The data engineer needs to improve the data encoding for the tables that have sub-optimal encoding. Which solution will meet this requirement?

options.A: Run the ANALYZE command against the identified tables. Manually update the compression encoding of columns based on the output of the command.
options.B: Run the ANALYZE COMPRESSION command against the identified tables. Manually update the compression encoding of columns based on the output of the command.
options.C: Run the VACUUM REINDEX command against the identified tables.
options.D: Run the VACUUM RECLUSTER command against the identified tables.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误：ANALYZE命令用于更新表的统计信息以优化查询性能，但它不会分析或建议压缩编码。
explanations.B: Correct. 正确：ANALYZE COMPRESSION命令会分析表的列并建议最佳的压缩编码。数据工程师可以根据输出手动更新列的压缩编码。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：VACUUM REINDEX命令用于重新索引表以优化查询性能，但它与压缩编码无关。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：VACUUM RECLUSTER命令用于重新组织表中的数据以优化查询性能，但它不会分析或优化压缩编码。

question: The company stores a large volume of customer records in Amazon S3. To comply with regulations, the company must be able to access new customer records immediately for the first 30 days after the records are created. The company accesses records that are older than 30 days infrequently. The company needs to cost-optimize its Amazon S3 storage. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Apply a lifecycle policy to transition records to S3 Standard Infrequent-Access (S3 Standard-IA) storage after 30 days.
options.B: Use S3 Intelligent-Tiering storage.
options.C: Transition records to S3 Glacier Deep Archive storage after 30 days.
options.D: Use S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) storage for all customer records.

explanations.A: Correct. 正确：S3 Standard-IA适用于访问频率较低但需要快速访问的数据。将数据在30天后转移到S3 Standard-IA可以降低存储成本，同时满 足访问需求。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 错误：虽然S3 Intelligent-Tiering可以自动优化存储成本，但它会产生额外的监控费用。对于明确的访问模式（如30天后访问频率降 低），使用生命周期策略更具成本效益。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：S3 Glacier Deep Archive适用于长期存储且访问频率极低的数据。题目要求30天后仍需偶尔访问数据，而Glacier Deep Archive的 检索时间较长，不符合需求。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：S3 Standard-IA的存储成本低于S3 Standard，但其访问成本较高。对于前30天需要频繁访问的数据，使用S3 Standard更合适。

question: A data engineer is using Amazon QuickSight to build a dashboard to report a company’s revenue in multiple AWS Regions. The data engineer wants the dashboard to display the total revenue for a Region, regardless of the drill-down levels shown in the visual. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a table calculation.
options.B: Create a simple calculated field.
options.C: Create a level-aware calculation - aggregate (LAC-A) function.
options.D: Create a level-aware calculation - window (LAC-W) function.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 表计算是基于可视化中的数据进行计算的，通常依赖于当前的钻取级别。它无法满足“无论钻取级别如何，总是显示区域总收入”的 要求，因此此选项错误。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 简单的计算字段是基于数据集中的字段进行计算的，但它不具备级别感知功能，无法在不同的聚合级别上执行计算。因此此选项错 误。
explanations.C: Correct. 级别感知计算中的聚合函数（LAC-A）允许用户定义计算的聚合级别，而不受可视化中的钻取级别影响。它可以满足“无论钻取级别 如何，总是显示区域总收入”的要求，因此此选项正确。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 窗口函数（LAC-W）通常用于基于窗口的计算，例如排名或移动平均。虽然它是级别感知的，但它不适合用于计算区域总收入，因 此此选项错误。

question: A retail company stores customer data in an Amazon S3 bucket. Some of the customer data contains personally identifiable information (PII) about customers. The company must not share PII data with business partners. A data engineer must determine whether a dataset contains PII before making objects in the dataset available to business partners. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST manual intervention?

options.A: Configure the S3 bucket and S3 objects to allow access to Amazon Macie. Use automated sensitive data discovery in Macie.
options.B: Configure AWS CloudTrail to monitor S3 PUT operations. Inspect the CloudTrail trails to identify operations that save PII.
options.C: Create an AWS Lambda function to identify PII in S3 objects. Schedule the function to run periodically.
options.D: Create a table in AWS Glue Data Catalog. Write custom SQL queries to identify PII in the table. Use Amazon Athena to run the queries.

explanations.A: Correct. 正确：Amazon Macie 是专门设计用于自动发现敏感数据（如 PII）的服务。它可以扫描 S3 存储桶中的数据并标记敏感信息，减少手 动干预。 最少的人工干预：Macie 的自动化功能使其成为解决此问题的最佳选择。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 错误：CloudTrail 主要用于记录 API 调用和操作日志，而不是直接识别数据内容。需要人工检查日志才能识别 PII，增加了手动干预。 不适合自动化识别 PII 数据。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：虽然 Lambda 可以编写自定义代码来识别 PII，但需要开发和维护代码，增加了复杂性和人工干预。 相比 Macie 的自动化功能，Lambda 的解决方案效率较低。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：此方法需要手动编写 SQL 查询来识别 PII，增加了人工干预。 虽然 Glue 和 Athena 可以处理数据，但它们不是专门设计用于自动发现敏感数据的工具。

question: A data engineer needs to create an empty copy of an existing table in Amazon Athena to perform data processing tasks. The existing table in Athena contains 1,000 rows. Which query will meet this requirement?

options.A: CREATE TABLE new_table - LIKE old_table;
options.B: CREATE TABLE new_table - AS SELECT * FROM old_table - WITH NO DATA;
options.C: CREATE TABLE new_table - AS SELECT * FROM old_table;
options.D: CREATE TABLE new_table - as SELECT * FROM old_cable - WHERE 1=1;

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误：Athena不支持直接使用“LIKE”关键字来创建表。此语法在Athena中无效。
explanations.B: Correct. 正确：此语法在Athena中有效。使用“WITH NO DATA”可以创建一个新表，其结构与旧表相同，但不复制数据。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：此语法会创建一个新表并复制旧表中的所有数据（1,000行）。题目要求创建一个空表，因此不符合要求。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：此语法会复制旧表中的所有数据（1,000行），因为“WHERE 1=1”是一个始终为真的条件。题目要求创建一个空表，因此不符合 要求。

question: A company has a data lake in Amazon S3. The company collects AWS CloudTrail logs for multiple applications. The company stores the logs in the data lake, catalogs the logs in AWS Glue, and partitions the logs based on the year. The company uses Amazon Athena to analyze the logs. Recently, customers reported that a query on one of the Athena tables did not return any data. A data engineer must resolve the issue. Which combination of troubleshooting steps should the data engineer take? (Choose two.)

options.A: Confirm that Athena is pointing to the correct Amazon S3 location.
options.B: Increase the query timeout duration.
options.C: Use the MSCK REPAIR TABLE command.
options.D: Restart Athena.
options.E: Delete and recreate the problematic Athena table.

explanations.A: Correct. 正确：如果Athena指向的S3路径不正确，查询将无法找到数据。这是排查问题的关键步骤。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 错误：查询超时通常与数据量或查询复杂度有关，而不是数据未返回的问题的根本原因。
explanations.C: Correct. 正确：MSCK REPAIR TABLE命令用于修复分区表。如果新分区未被Glue数据目录识别，Athena查询可能无法返回数据。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：Athena是无服务器的服务，重启并不是解决问题的有效方法。
explanations.E: Incorrect. 错误：删除和重新创建表可能会丢失元数据，且不是解决问题的最佳实践。

question: A data engineer wants to orchestrate a set of extract, transform, and load (ETL) jobs that run on AWS. The ETL jobs contain tasks that must run Apache Spark jobs on Amazon EMR, make API calls to Salesforce, and load data into Amazon Redshift. The ETL jobs need to handle failures and retries automatically. The data engineer needs to use Python to orchestrate the jobs. Which service will meet these requirements?

options.A: Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (Amazon MWAA)
options.B: AWS Step Functions
options.C: AWS Glue
options.D: Amazon EventBridge

explanations.A: Correct. Amazon MWAA是一个托管的Apache Airflow服务，支持使用Python编写工作流。 它可以轻松编排复杂的ETL任务，包括运行Spark作业、调用外部API（如Salesforce）、以及加载数据到Amazon Redshift。 Apache Airflow本身支持任务失败处理和重试机制，因此满足题目要求。 正确选项。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 是一个可视化的工作流编排服务，支持任务失败处理和重试机制。 虽然Step Functions可以编排多个AWS服务，但它不直接支持Python代码编写工作流，且对外部API调用（如Salesforce）需要额外的 Lambda函数支持。 不完全满足题目要求。 错误选项。
explanations.C: Incorrect. AWS Glue AWS Glue是一个ETL服务，主要用于数据转换和加载任务。 虽然Glue支持运行Spark作业，但它不适合编排复杂的工作流（如API调用和多任务依赖）。 不完全满足题目要求。 错误选项。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 是一个事件总线服务，主要用于事件驱动的架构设计。 它不支持直接编排复杂的ETL工作流，也不支持Python代码编写工作流。 不满足题目要求。 错误选项。

question: A data engineer maintains custom Python scripts that perform a data formatting process that many AWS Lambda functions use. When the data engineer needs to modify the Python scripts, the data engineer must manually update all the Lambda functions. The data engineer requires a less manual way to update the Lambda functions. Which solution will meet this requirement?

options.A: Store the custom Python scripts in a shared Amazon S3 bucket. Store a pointer to the custom scripts in the execution context object.
options.B: Package the custom Python scripts into Lambda layers. Apply the Lambda layers to the Lambda functions.
options.C: Store the custom Python scripts in a shared Amazon S3 bucket. Store a pointer to the customer scripts in environment variables.
options.D: Assign the same alias to each Lambda function. Call each Lambda function by specifying the function's alias.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误：虽然可以将脚本存储在 S3 中并通过指针引用，但 Lambda 函数的执行环境并不直接支持从 S3 动态加载代码。这样做需要额 外的代码逻辑来下载和加载脚本，增加了复杂性。
explanations.B: Correct. 正确：Lambda Layers 是专门设计用于共享代码或依赖项的功能。通过将 Python 脚本打包到 Lambda Layers 中，可以轻松地将其应用 到多个 Lambda 函数，并且更新 Layers 后，所有引用该 Layers 的函数都会自动使用最新版本。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：虽然环境变量可以存储指针，但这仍然需要额外的逻辑来从 S3 下载和加载脚本。与选项 A 类似，这种方法增加了复杂性， 并且不如 Lambda Layers 高效。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：Lambda 别名用于版本管理，而不是代码共享。此选项与题目要求的减少手动更新脚本的需求无关。

question: A company stores customer data in an Amazon S3 bucket. Multiple teams in the company want to use the customer data for downstream analysis. The company needs to ensure that the teams do not have access to personally identifiable information (PII) about the customers. Which solution will meet this requirement with LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use Amazon Macie to create and run a sensitive data discovery job to detect and remove PII.
options.B: Use S3 Object Lambda to access the data, and use Amazon Comprehend to detect and remove PII.
options.C: Use Amazon Data Firehose and Amazon Comprehend to detect and remove PII.
options.D: Use an AWS Glue DataBrew job to store the PII data in a second S3 bucket. Perform analysis on the data that remains in the original S3 bucket.

explanations.A: Incorrect. Amazon Macie 是一个敏感数据发现服务，可以检测 PII 数据。 然而，Macie 的主要功能是发现和报告敏感数据，而不是直接移除 PII 数据。 需要额外的步骤和工具来处理和移除 PII 数据，因此操作开销较高。 错误原因：无法直接满足“检测和移除 PII”的需求，操作开销较高。
explanations.B: Correct. S3 Object Lambda 允许在访问 S3 数据时动态修改数据。 Amazon Comprehend 提供 PII 检测功能，可以在数据访问时动态移除 PII。 此解决方案直接在数据访问过程中处理 PII，减少了额外的操作步骤。 正确原因：动态处理 PII 数据，操作开销最低，符合题目要求。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Amazon Data Firehose 是一个数据流服务，通常用于将数据传输到存储或分析工具。 虽然可以结合 Amazon Comprehend 检测 PII，但需要额外的配置和步骤来处理数据。 操作开销较高，不是最优解决方案。 错误原因：需要额外的配置和步骤，操作开销较高。
explanations.D: Incorrect. AWS Glue DataBrew 是一个数据准备工具，可以清理和转换数据。 此选项需要将 PII 数据分离到另一个 S3 bucket，增加了数据管理的复杂性。 操作开销较高，不符合“最少操作开销”的要求。 错误原因：需要额外的存储和管理步骤，操作开销较高。

question: A company stores its processed data in an S3 bucket. The company has a strict data access policy. The company uses IAM roles to grant teams within the company different levels of access to the S3 bucket. The company wants to receive notifications when a user violates the data access policy. Each notification must include the username of the user who violated the policy. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Config rules to detect violations of the data access policy. Set up compliance alarms.
options.B: Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics to gather object-level metrics. Set up CloudWatch alarms.
options.C: Use AWS CloudTrail to track object-level events for the S3 bucket. Forward events to Amazon CloudWatch to set up CloudWatch alarms.
options.D: Use Amazon S3 server access logs to monitor access to the bucket. Forward the access logs to an Amazon CloudWatch log group. Use metric filters on the log group to set up CloudWatch alarms.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误：AWS Config 主要用于资源配置的合规性检查，而不是实时监控用户对 S3 数据的访问行为。 无法直接提供用户身份信息，也无法实时触发通知。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 错误：CloudWatch metrics 主要用于监控资源的性能指标（如 CPU 使用率、网络流量等），而不是对象级别的访问事件。 无法追踪用户身份，也无法检测数据访问策略的违规行为。
explanations.C: Correct. 正确：AWS CloudTrail 可以记录 S3 bucket 的对象级事件，包括用户身份信息。 可以将事件转发到 CloudWatch，并设置警报以检测违规行为。 完全满足题目要求，包括提供用户名和实时通知。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：S3 server access logs 可以记录访问行为，但日志处理是异步的，无法实时触发通知。 需要额外的日志解析步骤才能提取用户身份信息，复杂度较高。

question: A company needs to load customer data that comes from a third party into an Amazon Redshift data warehouse. The company stores order data and product data in the same data warehouse. The company wants to use the combined dataset to identify potential new customers. A data engineer notices that one of the fields in the source data includes values that are in JSON format. How should the data engineer load the JSON data into the data warehouse with the LEAST effort?

options.A: Use the SUPER data type to store the data in the Amazon Redshift table.
options.B: Use AWS Glue to flatten the JSON data and ingest it into the Amazon Redshift table.
options.C: Use Amazon S3 to store the JSON data. Use Amazon Athena to query the data.
options.D: Use an AWS Lambda function to flatten the JSON data. Store the data in Amazon S3.

explanations.A: Correct. 正确：Amazon Redshift的SUPER数据类型专门设计用于存储和查询半结构化数据（如JSON）。它允许直接存储JSON数据，无需额外的 转换或展平操作。 最少的开发工作量：无需使用外部工具或服务来处理JSON数据。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 错误：虽然AWS Glue可以展平JSON数据并将其加载到Redshift中，但这需要额外的配置和开发工作。 相比使用SUPER数据类型，这种方法增加了复杂性，不符合题目要求的“LEAST effort”。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：将数据存储在Amazon S3并使用Athena查询虽然是一种可行的解决方案，但它并未将数据加载到Amazon Redshift中。 题目明确要求将数据加载到Amazon Redshift数据仓库中，因此此选项不符合要求。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：使用Lambda函数展平JSON数据并存储到S3虽然是一种处理JSON数据的方法，但它并未将数据加载到Amazon Redshift中。 此选项增加了开发复杂性，不符合题目要求的“LEAST effort”。

question: A company wants to analyze sales records that the company stores in a MySQL database. The company wants to correlate the records with sales opportunities identified by Salesforce. The company receives 2 GB of sales records every day. The company has 100 GB of identified sales opportunities. A data engineer needs to develop a process that will analyze and correlate sales records and sales opportunities. The process must run once each night. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (Amazon MWAA) to fetch both datasets. Use AWS Lambda functions to correlate the datasets. Use AWS Step Functions to orchestrate the process.
options.B: Use Amazon AppFlow to fetch sales opportunities from Salesforce. Use AWS Glue to fetch sales records from the MySQL database. Correlate the sales records with the sales opportunities. Use Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (Amazon MWAA) to orchestrate the process.
options.C: Use Amazon AppFlow to fetch sales opportunities from Salesforce. Use AWS Glue to fetch sales records from the MySQL database. Correlate the sales records with sales opportunities. Use AWS Step Functions to orchestrate the process.
options.D: Use Amazon AppFlow to fetch sales opportunities from Salesforce. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to fetch sales records from the MySQL database. Use Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink to correlate the datasets. Use AWS Step Functions to orchestrate the process.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 使用Amazon MWAA、AWS Lambda和AWS Step Functions 正确性分析：Amazon MWAA可以用于编排工作流，但使用AWS Lambda来处理和关联数据集可能不适合处理大规模数据（如每天2GB 的销售记录和100GB的销售机会）。Lambda的内存和执行时间限制可能会导致性能问题。 错误原因：此方案的操作开销较高，因为需要手动管理Lambda函数的性能和扩展性。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 使用Amazon AppFlow、AWS Glue和Amazon MWAA 正确性分析：Amazon AppFlow可以轻松从Salesforce提取数据，AWS Glue适合从MySQL提取和处理数据。Amazon MWAA可以编排工作 流。 错误原因：虽然此方案功能上可行，但Amazon MWAA的操作开销比AWS Step Functions更高，因为MWAA需要管理Apache Airflow环 境。
explanations.C: Correct. 使用Amazon AppFlow、AWS Glue和AWS Step Functions 正确性分析：Amazon AppFlow可以从Salesforce提取数据，AWS Glue可以从MySQL提取和处理数据。AWS Step Functions是一个托管服 务，适合编排工作流，且操作开销较低。 正确原因：此方案使用了托管服务，减少了操作开销，同时满足了数据集成、处理和编排的需求。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 使用Amazon AppFlow、Amazon Kinesis Data Streams、Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink和AWS Step Functions 正确性分析：Amazon AppFlow可以从Salesforce提取数据，Amazon Kinesis Data Streams适合实时数据流处理，但题目要求的是每天一 次的批处理，而不是实时处理。Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink适合流式数据处理，但不适合批处理。 错误原因：此方案过于复杂且不符合题目要求的批处理场景，增加了不必要的操作开销。

question: A company stores server logs in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company needs to keep the logs for 1 year. The logs are not required after 1 year. A data engineer needs a solution to automatically delete logs that are older than 1 year. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Define an S3 Lifecycle configuration to delete the logs after 1 year.
options.B: Create an AWS Lambda function to delete the logs after 1 year.
options.C: Schedule a cron job on an Amazon EC2 instance to delete the logs after 1 year.
options.D: Configure an AWS Step Functions state machine to delete the logs after 1 year.

explanations.A: Correct. 正确：Amazon S3 Lifecycle配置是一种内置功能，允许用户根据对象的年龄自动执行操作（如删除或转移到其他存储层）。 最低操作开销：无需额外的代码或资源，完全由S3管理。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 错误：虽然Lambda可以实现自动化，但需要编写代码、设置触发器，并可能涉及额外的监控和维护。 操作开销较高：相比S3 Lifecycle，Lambda需要更多的配置和管理。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：使用EC2实例运行cron作业需要持续运行实例，增加成本和管理复杂性。 操作开销最高：需要维护EC2实例、管理作业调度，并确保脚本正常运行。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：Step Functions适用于复杂的工作流管理，而本题需求非常简单，使用Step Functions显得过于复杂。 操作开销较高：需要设计状态机、编写逻辑，并管理相关资源。

question: A company is designing a serverless data processing workflow in AWS Step Functions that involves multiple steps. The processing workflow ingests data from an external API, transforms the data by using multiple AWS Lambda functions, and loads the transformed data into Amazon DynamoDB. The company needs the workflow to perform specific steps based on the content of the incoming data. Which Step Functions state type should the company use to meet this requirement?

options.A: Parallel
options.B: Choice
options.C: Task
options.D: Map

explanations.A: Incorrect. 状态用于并行执行多个分支的任务。虽然可以同时处理多个任务，但它不适合根据数据内容进行条件判断，因此 此选项错误。
explanations.B: Correct. Choice: Choice状态允许根据输入数据的内容定义条件，并执行不同的分支逻辑。此状态正是用于根据数据内容选择不同的步骤， 因此此选项正确。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Task: Task状态用于执行单个任务，例如调用Lambda函数或其他服务。它不能根据数据内容进行条件判断，因此此选项错误。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Map: Map状态用于对数组中的每个元素执行相同的任务。它适合处理批量数据，但不适合根据数据内容执行条件逻辑，因此此选 项错误。

question: A data engineer created a table named cloudtrail_logs in Amazon Athena to query AWS CloudTrail logs and prepare data for audits. The data engineer needs to write a query to display errors with error codes that have occurred since the beginning of 2024. The query must return the 10 most recent errors. Which query will meet these requirements?

options.B: select count (*) as TotalEvents, eventname, errorcode, errormessage from cloudtrail_logs where eventtime >= '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z' group by eventname, errorcode, errormessage order by TotalEvents desc limit 10;
options.C: select count (*) as TotalEvents, eventname, errorcode, errormessage from cloudtrail_logs where eventtime >= '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z' group by eventname, errorcode, errormessage order by eventname asc limit 10;
options.D: select count (*) as TotalEvents, eventname, errorcode, errormessage from cloudtrail_logs where errorcode is not null and eventtime >= '2024- 01-01T00:00:00Z' group by eventname, errorcode, errormessage limit 10;

question: An online retailer uses multiple delivery partners to deliver products to customers. The delivery partners send order summaries to the retailer. question: A company has an Amazon Redshift data warehouse that users access by using a variety of IAM roles. More than 100 users access the data warehouse every day. The company wants to control user access to the objects based on each user's job role, permissions, and how sensitive the data is. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use the role-based access control (RBAC) feature of Amazon Redshift.
options.B: Use the row-level security (RLS) feature of Amazon Redshift.
options.C: Use the column-level security (CLS) feature of Amazon Redshift.
options.D: Use dynamic data masking policies in Amazon Redshift.

explanations.A: Correct. RBAC允许管理员根据用户的角色定义权限，从而实现基于角色的访问控制。 这种方法非常适合场景中提到的“根据用户的工作角色和权限控制访问”。 正确选项。
explanations.B: Incorrect. RLS主要用于控制用户对特定行的访问权限。 虽然可以实现一定程度的访问控制，但它更适合基于数据内容的访问限制，而不是基于用户角色的访问控制。 错误选项。
explanations.C: Incorrect. CLS用于控制用户对特定列的访问权限。 虽然可以保护敏感数据，但它无法根据用户的角色动态调整权限。 错误选项。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 动态数据屏蔽用于隐藏敏感数据，但它主要是针对数据展示层面的保护，而不是基于用户角色的全面访问控制。 错误选项。
